YELLOW.BluesHouseDaisyWalkingText: Spending time with your POKéMON makes them more friendly to you.
YELLOW.CeladonCityGameCornerSignText: ROCKET GAME CORNER The playground for grownups!
YELLOW.CeladonCityGymSignText: CELADON CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: ERIKA The Nature-Loving Princess!
YELLOW.CeladonCityLittleGirlText: I got my KOFFING from my friend! We get along now, because I was very nice to it!
YELLOW.CeladonMansion1Text11: Your PIKACHU looks happy with you.
YELLOW.CeladonMansion1Text12: You look like a fantastic duo. You're making me jealous!
YELLOW.CeladonMansion1Text2: My dear POKéMON keep me company. MEOWTH even brings money home!
YELLOW.CeladonMansion1Text6: Oh, you have an adorable PIKACHU with you.@
YELLOW.CeladonMansion1Text7: It seems like it hasn't been tamed at all.
YELLOW.CeladonMansion1Text8: Why don't you take more care with PIKACHU?
YELLOW.CeladonMansion1Text9: You must be happy to have a POKéMON that cute.
YELLOW.CeladonMansion3FGameDesignerCompletedDex: Go show off your DIPLOMA to the development crew.
YELLOW.CeladonMansion3FGraphicArtistText2: I'm the graphic artist! Wow, you finished your POKéDEX! Want me to PRINT out a DIPLOMA as proof?
YELLOW.CeladonMansion3FGraphicArtistText3: Just tell me if you want to PRINT out a DIPLOMA.
YELLOW.CeladonMansion3FProgrammerText2: Me? I'm the programmer! What a surprise! I never expected anyone to fill a POKéDEX.
YELLOW.CeladonMansion3FWriterText2: I wrote the story! It's great you caught all the POKéMON! Thanks!
YELLOW.CeladonMart4FSuperNerdText: I'm getting a gift for COPYCAT in CERULEAN CITY. It's got to be a POKé DOLL. They are trendy!
YELLOW.CeruleanBadgeHouseBoulderBadgeText: The ATTACK of all POKéMON increases a little bit. It also lets you use FLASH any- time you desire.
YELLOW.CeruleanBadgeHouseMiddleAgedManVisitAnyT: Come visit me any- time you wish.
YELLOW.CeruleanCityCooltrainerF1ElectrodePunchT: ELECTRODE, TACKLE! No! You blew it again!
YELLOW.CeruleanCityCooltrainerF1ElectrodeUseSon: OK! ELECTRODE! Use SONICBOOM! Please ELECTRODE, pay attention!
YELLOW.CeruleanCityCooltrainerF1ElectrodeWithdr: ELECTRODE, SWIFT! No! That's wrong! Training POKéMON is difficult! Your POKéMON's obedience depends on your abilities as a trainer!
YELLOW.CeruleanCityGuardText: These poor people here were robbed. We're positive that TEAM ROCKET is behind this terrible deed. Even our POLICE FORCE has trouble with the ROCKETs!
YELLOW.CeruleanGymGymGuideBeatMistyText: You beat MISTY! What'd I tell ya? You and me, kid, we make a pretty darn good team!
YELLOW.CeruleanGymMistyCascadeBadgeInfoText: The CASCADEBADGE makes all POKéMON up to L30 obey! That includes even outsiders! There's more, you can now use CUT anytime! You can CUT down small bushes to open new paths! You can also have my favorite TM!
YELLOW.CeruleanGymMistyPreBattleText: Hi, you're a new face! What's your policy on POKéMON? What is your approach? My policy is an all-out offensive with water-type POKéMON! MISTY, the world- famous beauty, is your host! Are you ready, sweetie?
YELLOW.CeruleanGymMistyReceivedCascadeBadgeText: I can't believe I lost! All right! You can have the CASCADEBADGE to show you beat me!
YELLOW.CinnabarGymText_1: This GYM is also known as the QUIZ GYM. You have to take a quiz if you want to see BLAINE. You don't have to fight us if you get it right.
YELLOW.CinnabarGymText_5: I like it here at QUIZ GYM.
YELLOW.CinnabarIslandGamblerText: Scientists conduct experiments in the burned-out building.
YELLOW.DaycareGentlemanCantAcceptMonWithHMText: I can't accept a POKéMON that knows an HM move.
YELLOW.DaycareGentlemanNoRoomForMonText: You have no room for this POKéMON!
YELLOW.DaycareGentlemanOnlyHaveOneMonText: You only have one POKéMON with you.
YELLOW.FanClubChairPrintText1: Hi there, {PLAYER}! Have you seen my POKéMON photos? I have them framed up on that wall. Ah, I know! Would you like me to take a photo of your POKéMON?
YELLOW.FanClubChairPrintText4: Maybe we won't PRINT this now.
YELLOW.FuchsiaCityGymSignText: FUCHSIA CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: KOGA The Poisonous Ninja Master!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymGymGuideBeatKogaText: It's amazing how ninja can terrify even now!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymGymGuideChampInMakingText: Yo! Champ in making! FUCHSIA GYM is riddled with invisible walls! KOGA might appear close, but he's blocked off! You have to find gaps in the walls to reach him!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymKogaPostBattleAdviceText: When afflicted by TOXIC, POKéMON suffer more and more as battle progresses! It will surely terrorize foes!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymKogaSoulBadgeInfoText: Now that you have the SOULBADGE, the DEFENSE of your POKéMON increases! It also lets you SURF outside of battle! Ah! Take this too!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymKogaTM06ExplanationText: TM06 contains TOXIC! It is a secret technique over 400 years old!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymRocker1AfterBattleText: So, you mix brawn with brains? Good strategy!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymRocker1BattleText: Strength isn't the key for POKéMON! It's strategy! I'll show you how strategy can beat brute strength!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymRocker2AfterBattleText: I will keep on training under KOGA, my ninja master!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymRocker2BattleText: I wanted to become a ninja, so I joined this GYM!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymRocker3AfterBattleText: I like poison and sleep techniques, as they linger after battle!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymRocker3BattleText: Let's see you beat my special techniques!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymRocker4AfterBattleText: You impressed me! Here's a hint! Look very closely for gaps in the invisible walls!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymRocker4BattleText: Stop right there! Our invisible walls have you frustrated?
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymRocker5AfterBattleText: I still have much to learn!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymRocker5BattleText: I also study the way of the ninja with master KOGA! Ninja have a long history of using animals!
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymRocker6AfterBattleText: Where there is light, there is shadow! Light and shadow! Which do you choose?
YELLOW.FuchsiaGymRocker6BattleText: Master KOGA comes from a long line of ninjas! What did you descend from?
YELLOW.GameCornerClerkCoinCaseIsFullText: Oops! Your COIN CASE is full.
YELLOW.GameCornerClerkDoYouNeedSomeGameCoinsTex: Welcome to ROCKET GAME CORNER! Do you need some game coins? It's ¥1000 for 50 coins. Would you like some?
YELLOW.GameCornerClerkDontHaveCoinCaseText: You don't have a COIN CASE!
YELLOW.GameCornerFishingGuru1WantToPlayText: Kid, do you want to play?
YELLOW.GameCornerFishingGuru1WinsComeAndGoText: Wins seem to come and go.
YELLOW.GameCornerFishingGuru2CloselyWatchTheRee: The trick is to watch the reels closely!
YELLOW.GameCornerFishingGuru2ThrowingMeOffText: Hey, what? You're throwing me off! Here are some coins, shoo!
YELLOW.GameCornerMiddleAgedMan2INeedMoreCoinsTe: Darn! I need more coins for the POKéMON I want!
YELLOW.HallOfFameOakText: OAK: Er-hem! Congratulations, {PLAYER}! This floor is the POKéMON HALL OF FAME! POKéMON LEAGUE champions are honored for their exploits here! Their POKéMON are also recorded in the HALL OF FAME! {PLAYER}! You have endeavored hard to become the new LEAGUE champion! Congratulations, {PLAYER}, you and your POKéMON are HALL OF FAMERs!
YELLOW.LancesRoomLanceBeforeBattleText: Ah! I heard about you, {PLAYER}! I lead the ELITE FOUR! You can call me LANCE the dragon trainer! You know that dragons are mythical POKéMON! They're hard to catch and raise, but their powers are superior! They're virtually indestructible! Well, are you ready to lose? Your LEAGUE challenge ends with me, {PLAYER}!
YELLOW.MelanieText1: I take care of injured POKéMON. I nursed this BULBASAUR back to health. It needs a good trainer to take care of it now.@
YELLOW.MelanieText2: I know! Would you take care of this BULBASAUR?
YELLOW.MtMoonJessieJamesText2: That fossil is TEAM ROCKET's! Surrender now, or prepare to fight!
YELLOW.MtMoonJessieJamesText4: TEAM ROCKET, blast off at the speed of light!@
YELLOW.Museum1FScientist2TakeThisToAPokemonLabT: Ssh! I think that this chunk of AMBER contains POKéMON DNA! It would be great if POKéMON could be resurrected from it! But, my colleagues just ignore me! So, I have a favor to ask! Take this to a POKéMON LAB and get it examined!
YELLOW.Museum2FPikachuText1: Your PIKACHU looks untamed. May I have it for my daughter?
YELLOW.Museum2FPikachuText2: I'd like to get that PIKACHU off you, but it's too attached to you.
YELLOW.NameRatersHouseNameRaterComeAnyTimeYouLi: Fine! Come any- time you like!
YELLOW.OaksLabGivePokeballsExplanationText: When a wild POKéMON appears, it's fair game. Just like I showed you, throw a POKé BALL at it and try to catch it! This won't always work, though. A healthy POKéMON could escape. You have to be lucky!
YELLOW.OaksLabOak1ParcelThanksText: Ah! This is the custom POKé BALL I ordered! Thanks, {PLAYER}! By the way, I must ask you to do something for me.
YELLOW.OaksLabOak1YouShouldTalkToIt: OAK: You should talk to it and see how it feels.
YELLOW.OaksLabOak1YourPokemonCanFightText: OAK: If a wild POKéMON appears, your POKéMON can fight against it! Afterward, go on to the next town.
YELLOW.OaksLabOakBePatientText: OAK: Be patient, {RIVAL}, I'll give you one later.
YELLOW.OaksLabOakChooseMonText: OAK: Hmm? {RIVAL}? Why are you here already? I said for you to come by later... Ah, whatever! Just wait there. Look, {PLAYER}! Do you see that ball on the table? It's called a POKé BALL. It holds a POKéMON inside. You may have it! Go on, take it!
YELLOW.OaksLabOakGivesText: OAK: {PLAYER}, this is the POKéMON I caught earlier. You can have it. I caught it in the wild and it's not tame yet.
YELLOW.OaksLabOakIHaveARequestText: OAK: Ah, {RIVAL}, good timing! I needed to ask both of you to do something for me.
YELLOW.OaksLabPikachuDislikesPokeballsText2: OAK: Would you look at that! It's odd, but it appears that your PIKACHU dislikes POKé BALLs. You should just keep it with you. That should make it happy! You can talk to it and see how it feels about you.
YELLOW.OaksLabRivalGrampsIsntAroundText: {RIVAL}: Yo {PLAYER}! Gramps isn't around! I ran here 'cos he said he had a POKéMON for me.
YELLOW.OaksLabRivalIllGetABetterPokemonThanYou: {RIVAL}: Humph! I'll get a better POKéMON than you!
YELLOW.OaksLabRivalMyPokemonHasGrownStrongerTex: {RIVAL}: Gramps, my POKéMON has grown stronger! Check it out!
YELLOW.OaksLabRivalMyPokemonLooksStrongerText: {RIVAL}: Heh, my POKéMON looks a lot stronger.
YELLOW.OaksLabRivalTakesText1: {RIVAL}: No way! {PLAYER}, I want this POKéMON!
YELLOW.OaksLabRivalTakesText5: OAK: But, I... Oh, all right then. That POKéMON is yours. I was going to give you one anyway... {PLAYER}, come over here.
YELLOW.OaksLabThatsAPokeball: That's a POKé BALL. There's a POKéMON inside!
YELLOW.OfficerJennyText1: I just caught a SQUIRTLE that was always getting into mischief. I think it needs a good trainer to set it straight.
YELLOW.OfficerJennyText2: You have the THUNDERBADGE!? You must be a good trainer! I just caught a SQUIRTLE that was always getting into mischief. Would you take good care of it?
YELLOW.OfficerJennyText4: Oh... What am I to do now?
YELLOW.PalletTownOakComeWithMe: OAK: A POKéMON can appear anytime in tall grass. You need your own POKéMON for your protection. I know! Here, come with me!
YELLOW.PalletTownOakThatWasCloseText: OAK: That was close! Wild POKéMON live in tall grass!
YELLOW.PewterGymBrockBoulderBadgeInfoText: That's an official POKéMON LEAGUE BADGE! Its bearer's POKéMON become more powerful! The technique FLASH can now be used anytime!
YELLOW.PewterGymBrockPostBattleAdviceText: There are all kinds of trainers in the world! Some raise POKéMON for fights. Some see them as pets. I'm in training to become a POKéMON breeder. If you take your POKéMON training seriously, go visit the GYM in CERULEAN and test your abilities!
YELLOW.PewterGymBrockReceivedBoulderBadgeText: I took you for granted. As proof of your victory, here's the BOULDERBADGE! {PLAYER} received the BOULDERBADGE!@
YELLOW.PewterGymCooltrainerMAfterBattleText: You're pretty hot, but not as hot as BROCK!
YELLOW.PewterGymCooltrainerMBattleText: Stop right there, kid! You're still light years from facing BROCK!
YELLOW.PewterGymCooltrainerMEndBattleText: Darn! Light years isn't time! It measures distance!
YELLOW.PewterGymGuideAdviceText: The 1st POKéMON out in a match is at the top of the POKéMON LIST! By changing the order of POKéMON, matches could be made easier!
YELLOW.PewterGymGuideFreeServiceText: It's a free service! Let's get happening!
YELLOW.PewterGymGuidePostBattleText: Just as I thought! You're POKéMON champ material!
YELLOW.PewterGymGuidePreAdviceText: Hiya! I can tell you have what it takes to become a POKéMON champ! I'm no trainer, but I can tell you how to win! Let me take you to the top!
YELLOW.PewterGymGuyText: All right! Let's get happening! It will be tough for your PIKACHU at this GYM! Electric attacks are harmless to BROCK's ground- type POKéMON.
YELLOW.PewterGymTM34NoRoomText: You don't have room for this!
YELLOW.PewterMartYoungsterText: A shady old man got me to buy this really weird fish POKéMON! It's totally weak and it cost ¥500!
YELLOW.PewterPokecenterText3: POKéMON CENTERS are wonderful! They heal POKéMON completely. Even conditions like sleep, burn, poison and others are cured.
YELLOW.PokemonFanClubChairmanIntroText: I chair the POKéMON Fan Club! I have more than 100 POKéMON. I love them all! I'm very fussy when it comes to POKéMON! So... Did you come to hear me brag about my POKéMON?
YELLOW.PokemonFanClubClefairyFanBetterText: Humph! My CLEFAIRY is twice as cute as that one!
YELLOW.PokemonFanClubClefairyFanNormalText: Won't you admire my CLEFAIRY's adorable tail?
YELLOW.PokemonFanClubClefairyFanText: Our CHAIRMAN's new hobby is taking POKéMON photos. He gave me a nice PRINT of my cute CLEFAIRY.
YELLOW.PokemonFanClubReceptionistText: Our CHAIRMAN is very vocal about POKéMON.
YELLOW.PokemonFanClubSeelFanText: I'm going to hook up the cable to get a photo PRINT of my SEEL!
YELLOW.PokemonTowerJessieJamesText2: Grampa here wanted to complain, so we're setting him straight. So render yourself invisible, or prepare to fight!
YELLOW.PokemonTowerJessieJamesText4: Looks like TEAM ROCKET's blasting off again!@
YELLOW.RedsHouse1FMomWakeUpText: MOM: Right. All boys leave home someday. It said so on TV. PROF.OAK, next door, is looking for you.
YELLOW.RedsHouse1FMomYouShouldRestText: MOM: {PLAYER}, if you drive your POKéMON too hard, they'll dislike you. You should take a rest.
YELLOW.RockTunnelB1FHiker3AfterBattleText: I'll raise my POKéMON to beat yours, kid!
YELLOW.RockTunnelB1FSuperNerd3AfterBattleText: I'm an artist, not a fighter.
YELLOW.RockTunnelB1FSuperNerd3BattleText: I draw POKéMON when I'm home.
YELLOW.RocketHideoutB4FRocketAfterBattleText: Oh no! I dropped the LIFT KEY!
YELLOW.RocketHideoutB4FRocketBattleText: The elevator doesn't work? Who has the LIFT KEY?
YELLOW.RocketHideoutJessieJamesText2: How dare you humiliate us at MT.MOON! It's payback time, you brat!
YELLOW.RocketHideoutJessieJamesText4: Looks like TEAM ROCKET's blasting off again!@
YELLOW.Route10SuperNerd2BattleText: Hi, kid, want to see my POKéMON?
YELLOW.Route11SuperNerd2AfterBattleText: Well, better get back to work.
YELLOW.Route11Youngster4AfterBattleText: I better go find stronger ones!
YELLOW.Route11Youngster4BattleText: My POKéMON should be ready by now!
YELLOW.Route12Fisher4AfterBattleText: It's all right. Losing doesn't bug me anymore.
YELLOW.Route12Gate2FBrunetteGirlYouCanHaveThisT: My POKéMON's ashes are stored in POKéMON TOWER. You can have this TM. I don't need it anymore...
YELLOW.Route14CooltrainerM1AfterBattleText: You have some HMs, right? POKéMON can't ever forget those moves.
YELLOW.Route22RivalBeforeBattleText2: {RIVAL}: What? {PLAYER}! What a surprise to see you here! So you're going to POKéMON LEAGUE? You collected all the BADGEs too? That's cool! Then I'll whip you, {PLAYER}, as a warmup for POKéMON LEAGUE! Come on!
YELLOW.Route24CooltrainerF1AfterBattleText: I did my best, so I've no regrets!
YELLOW.Route24CooltrainerF2AfterBattleText: I did my best, I have no regrets!
YELLOW.Route24CooltrainerM2AfterBattleText: I hid because the people on the bridge scared me!
YELLOW.Route24CooltrainerM3AfterBattleText: I did my best, I have no regrets!
YELLOW.Route24CooltrainerM3BattleText: OK! I'm No. 5! I'll stomp you!
YELLOW.Route24DamianText1: I'm not good at raising POKéMON. I should release my CHARMANDER because I haven't raised it well... If you promise me you'll care for it, it's yours.
YELLOW.Route24DamianText2: Take good care of my CHARMANDER!@
YELLOW.Route24DamianText3: Oh... I'd better release it then.
YELLOW.Route24Youngster1AfterBattleText: I did my best, I have no regrets!
YELLOW.Route24Youngster1BattleText: Here's No. 3! I won't be easy!
YELLOW.Route24Youngster2AfterBattleText: I did my best, I have no regrets!
YELLOW.Route24Youngster2BattleText: This is NUGGET BRIDGE! Beat us 5 trainers and win a fabulous prize! Think you got what it takes?
YELLOW.Route3Youngster3EndBattleText: If I had new POKéMON, I would've won!
YELLOW.Route6CooltrainerF1AfterBattleText: Now I understand, POKéMON isn't about calculated numbers.
YELLOW.Route6CooltrainerF1BattleText: I'm training for my love. Don't bother me!
YELLOW.Route6CooltrainerM1AfterBattleText: My love will leave me in disgust.
YELLOW.Route6CooltrainerM1BattleText: I'm doing this out of love. Leave me alone!
YELLOW.Route8CooltrainerF3AfterBattleText: SAFFRON's gate- keeper won't let us through. He's so mean!
YELLOW.Route9AJAfterBattleText: I'll restart my 100-win streak with SANDSHREW.
YELLOW.Route9AJBattleText: I aim to be the ultimate trainer!
YELLOW.SSAnne2FRoomsGentleman3Text: In all my travels, I've never seen any POKéMON sleep like this one! It was something like this!
YELLOW.SSAnneCaptainsRoomCaptainIFeelMuchBetter: CAPTAIN: Whew! Thank you! I feel much better! You want to see my CUT technique? I could show you if I wasn't ill... I know! You can have this! Teach it to your POKéMON and you can see it CUT anytime!
YELLOW.SSAnneCaptainsRoomCaptainNotSickAnymoreT: CAPTAIN: Whew! Now that I'm not sick anymore, I guess it's time.
YELLOW.SSAnneKitchenCook7SalmonDuSaladText: Salade de Salmon! Les guests may gripe it's fish again, however!
YELLOW.SafariZoneGateSafariZoneWorker1ThatllBe5: That'll be ¥@ , please! We only use a special POKé BALL here. {PLAYER} received 30 SAFARI BALLs!@
YELLOW.SafariZoneLowCostText1: Oh, all right, pay me what you have.
YELLOW.SafariZoneLowCostText2: But, I can't give you all 30 BALLs.
YELLOW.SafariZoneLowCostText3: You're persistent, aren't you? OK, you can go in for free, but just this once!@
YELLOW.SafariZoneLowCostText5: I'm sorry, but you have to pay to enter.
YELLOW.SafariZoneLowCostText7: I said, no money, no entry!
YELLOW.SafariZoneLowCostText8: Read my lips, NO! Get it?
YELLOW.SilphCo11FGiovanniText: Ah, {PLAYER}! So we meet again! The PRESIDENT and I are discussing a vital business proposition. Keep your nose out of grown-up matters... or, experience a world of pain!
YELLOW.SilphCo2FRocket1AfterBattleText: Diamond-shaped tiles are teleport blocks! They're hi-tech transporters!
YELLOW.SilphCo5FPokemonReport1Text: It's a POKéMON REPORT! POKéMON LAB created PORYGON, the first virtual reality POKéMON.
YELLOW.SilphCo5FPokemonReport2Text: It's a POKéMON REPORT! Over 160 POKéMON techniques have been confirmed.
YELLOW.SilphCo5FPokemonReport3Text: It's a POKéMON REPORT! 4 POKéMON evolve only when traded by link-cable.
YELLOW.SilphCo5FRockerAfterBattleText: You're only on 5F. It's a long way to my BOSS!
YELLOW.SilphCo5FRockerBattleText: Whaaat? There shouldn't be any children here!
YELLOW.SilphCo5FRocket2AfterBattleText: Which reminds me. KOFFING evolves into WEEZING!
YELLOW.SilphCo5FRocket2BattleText: Show TEAM ROCKET a little respect!
YELLOW.SilphCo7FRivalDefeatedText: Oh-oh! So, you are ready for BOSS ROCKET!
YELLOW.SilphCo7FRocket1BattleText: Aha! I smell a little rat!
YELLOW.SilphCoJessieJamesText2: Our BOSS is in a meeting! You better not disturb him!
YELLOW.SilphCoJessieJamesText4: TEAM ROCKET, blast off at the speed of light! Again...@
YELLOW.SummerBeachHousePoster1Text1: SURFIN' DUDE's scribbles... When I shoot the tube, the tunes hit the groove!
YELLOW.SummerBeachHousePoster2Text1: SURFING TIP 1! After flips, line the board up with a wave for a cool effect!
YELLOW.SummerBeachHousePoster3Text1: SURFING TIP 2! Pulling flips in a jump is totally rad!
YELLOW.SummerBeachHousePoster3Text2: The sea unites all in surfdom!
YELLOW.SummerBeachHousePrinterText1: It's some sort of a machine...@
YELLOW.SummerBeachHousePrinterText2: SUMMER BEACH HOUSE PRINTER, it says.@
YELLOW.SummerBeachHousePrinterText3: The Hi-Score is shown. PRINT it out?
YELLOW.SummerBeachHousePrinterText4: SUMMER BEACH HOUSE PRINTER, it says. The Hi-Score is shown. PRINT it out?
YELLOW.SummerBeachHouseSurfinDudeText1: Whoa! Your PIKACHU knows how to SURF! So, I'm not alone... Great! You earned the right to SURF with the DUDE! Give it a go?
YELLOW.SummerBeachHouseSurfinDudeText4: Dogs and burgers on special today!
YELLOW.TM24ExplanationText: TM24 contains THUNDERBOLT! Teach it to an electric POKéMON!
YELLOW.TM34ExplanationText: A TM contains a technique that can be taught to POKéMON! A TM is good only once! So when you use one to teach a new technique, pick the POKéMON carefully! TM34 contains BIDE! Your POKéMON will absorb damage in battle then pay it back double!
YELLOW.VermilionGymGentlemanAfterBattleText: The door won't open? LT.SURGE always was cautious!
YELLOW.VermilionGymGentlemanBattleText: When I was in the Army, LT.SURGE was my strict CO!
YELLOW.VermilionGymGymGuideChampInMakingText: Yo! Champ in making! LT.SURGE has a nickname. People refer to him as the Lightning American! He's an expert on electric POKéMON! Birds and water POKéMON are at risk! Beware of paralysis too! LT.SURGE is very cautious! You'll have to break a code to get to him!
YELLOW.VermilionGymLTSurgePostBattleAdviceText: A little word of advice, kid! Electricity is sure powerful! But, it's useless against ground- type POKéMON!
YELLOW.VermilionGymLTSurgePreBattleText: Ten-hut! Welcome to VERMILION GYM! Will you look at that, a pint-size challenger! Hahaha! You've got big and brassy nerves to take me on with your puny power! A POKéMON battle is war! I'll show you, civilian! I'll shock you into surrender!
YELLOW.VermilionGymLTSurgeReceivedThunderBadgeT: Whoa! You're the real deal, kid! Fine then, take the THUNDERBADGE!
YELLOW.VermilionGymLTSurgeTM24NoRoomText: Yo kid, make room in your pack!
YELLOW.VermilionGymLTSurgeThunderBadgeInfoText: The THUNDERBADGE cranks up your POKéMON's SPEED! It also lets your POKéMON FLY any- time, kid! You're special, kid! Take this!
YELLOW.VermilionGymSailorAfterBattleText: LT.SURGE set up double locks! Here's a hint! When you open the 1st lock, the 2nd lock is right next to it!
YELLOW.VermilionGymSailorBattleText: This is no place for kids!
YELLOW.VermilionGymSuperNerdAfterBattleText: OK, I'll talk! LT.SURGE said he hid door switches inside something!
YELLOW.VermilionGymSuperNerdBattleText: I'm a lightweight, but I'm good with electricity!
YELLOW.ViridianCityOldManHadMyCoffeeNowText: Ahh, I've had my coffee now and I feel great! Sure, you can go through! I'm sorry I was so rude to you! I see you're using a POKéDEX. I'll show you how to catch POKéMON as my apology.
YELLOW.ViridianCityOldManLosingMyTouchText: That didn't work! I must be losing my touch. I've run out of POKé BALLs too. I have to get some at POKéMON MART.
YELLOW.ViridianCityOldManNotGoodEnoughForYouTex: Oh... I'm not good enough for you.
YELLOW.ViridianCityOldManWantMeToShowYouAgainTe: Hmm? You want me to show you how to catch POKéMON again?
YELLOW.ViridianCityOldManWatchCloselyText: Dandy! Watch what I do closely now!
YELLOW.ViridianCityYoungster1Text: Those POKé BALLs at your waist! You have POKéMON! It's great that you can carry and use POKéMON any- time, anywhere!
YELLOW.ViridianForestCooltrainerFAfterBattleTex: I looked forever, but I never found a PIKACHU here!
YELLOW.ViridianForestCooltrainerFBattleText: Hi, do you have a PIKACHU?
YELLOW.ViridianForestSouthGateLittleGirlText: You have to roam far to get new kinds of POKéMON. Look for other types outside of VIRIDIAN FOREST.
